implementation_notes: Three copies of a near-identical block: take the differing part as a keyword argument or a passed callable, and use `functools.singledispatch` when the difference is a type. Two copies stay two copies.
idiom_name: third copy -> parameter + callable, or singledispatch on type
pitfalls: Metaclass-heavy abstractions written at the second copy
A shared helper with a long default-argument list, which is a signal the cases differ in more than one way
